sections.subtitle: Share the operating details.
intro: First-mile support coordinates an accepted consignment from the origin facility to the relevant branch, hub or onward movement. Last-mile support coordinates the final leg from the network to the agreed consignee location.
Availability depends on local coverage, vehicle access, cargo, timing and delivery conditions. Clear contact details and site instructions help prevent avoidable delays at either end.

faqs.a: First-mile support covers the accepted pickup leg from a factory, warehouse or shipper location into the planned logistics movement.
Last-mile support covers the final accepted delivery leg from a branch, hub or godown to the industrial consignee location.
Availability varies by route, locality, cargo, vehicle access and service conditions. Share the full addresses so the team can check coverage.

faqs.q: Which location details help with planning?
faqs.a: Provide addresses, landmarks, contact people, operating hours, loading or unloading access and any appointment restrictions.

cards.title: Part Load Transport

cards.title: Container Transport to Ports
body: Container transport coordination between industrial locations and JNPT (Nhava Sheva), Hazira and Mundra ports.
